entry.name: tdpEnabled
entry.label: Whether a manual TDP limit is wanted.

entry.name: tdpLimit
entry.label: Limit to restore when the manual TDP limit is switched on. Zero is always the maximum.

entry.name: gpuManual
entry.label: Whether a manual GPU clock is wanted.

entry.name: gpuClock
entry.label: Clock to restore when the manual GPU clock is switched on. Zero is always the maximum.

entry.name: tdpProfile
entry.label: Performance profile the manual TDP limit was last set under.
